ofdma_ru_map.csv, residual-tone table and placement masks. All numbers, budgets and thresholds are synthetic educational assumptions, not system specifications or service guarantees. Use offline calculation or simulation without operating a transmitter.

stages.title: 一、建立系統邊界與輸入帳
stages.titleEn: 1. Define the system boundary and input ledger
stages.description: 閱讀來源 Wi-Fi 6 specific settings: OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BSS coloring and TWT，找出本課機制與適用範圍。以自己的圖解標示：OFDMA將頻域資源單位分給多使用者；裝箱須保留導頻、DC與保護配置，簡單tone預算不代表合法RU配置。 將輸入逐項抄入有單位的表：合成可用tone預算242；每用戶26 tone，先9用戶再10；用餘量呈現超額。 對每個量註明固定、改變、推導或未建模；將引用內容與教學假設分欄。
stages.descriptionEn: Read Wi-Fi 6 specific settings: OFDMA, MU-MIMO, BSS coloring and TWT to locate the mechanism and its scope. Draw your own model boundary: OFDMA assigns frequency RUs to users; legal layouts include pilot/DC/guard constraints, so a simple tone budget is not a standards-valid allocation. Transcribe the inputs into a unit-bearing ledger: Use a synthetic242-tone budget and26 tones per user; compare9 and10 users through signed remaining tones. Label each quantity fixed, changed, derived or unmodelled, separating sourced concepts from teaching assumptions.
